verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only navigation link titles such as "Simuler une taxe ou un crédit d'impôt", "Acheter un timbre fiscal" and "Payer en ligne". None of these show published statutory fee amounts for any transaction. The only figure-like mention is the phone line pricing ("Service gratuit + prix de l'appel"), which is not a statutory fee, so there is no evidence the service publishes exact fee amounts on its own pages.
